title: Public docs at babul.us contain about 20 internal links that return 404
description:
**Problem**
The live docs on https://babul.us and https://babulus.anth.us link to about 20 internal pages that do not exist. Some links are repo source paths used as docs routes.

**Evidence**
- /docs/rendering/{encoding,frames,performance,docker,monitoring,cost,troubleshooting}
- /docs/rendering-overview and /docs/components-layouts (apps/studio-web/lib/docs-content/videoml-standard.ts:718,725)
- /docs/components-guide, /docs/project-storage-architecture, /docs/tts-aws-polly-quickstart
- /docs/worker-job-spec and /docs/security-verification (technical.ts:88,96 in the same folder)
- source paths used as docs links, such as /docs/lib/project-storage.ts
- Example: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://babul.us/docs/rendering-overview` returns 404 (2026-10-20).

**Fix**
Point each link at an existing docs page, create the missing pages, or remove the links. Replace the source-path links with repository URLs.

**How to verify**
Crawl https://babul.us/docs and confirm every internal link returns 200, for example `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' <url>` on each.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
